The shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25 is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities: no life in being at the 1960 conveyance validates it, because an afterborn child can turn 25, and the land can first be used for church purposes, more than 21 years after every measuring life ends. Striking that interest leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute; later births and deaths do not revive it. Title is in the friend only (A).

CONFIDENCE: 78
